IFS FIGHT LEAGUE #2 — 23RD OCTOBER 

Following the success of IFS Fight League #1, we’re back for round two.

We won’t be the most active promotion around. Our plan is to put on just ONE event per year, but when we do, we want it to be BIG.

Our aim is simple. Quality over quantity. The best possible matchups, top-level production and a fight night that delivers from start to finish.

23RD OCTOBER 2027
📍 Hideout Sports Arena, Bolton

IFS FIGHT LEAGUE #2. Bigger and better.

More announcements coming soon.
